runtime_license_boundary.detail: The strict MIT/Apache-2.0 Cargo package audits and selected-source guards pass without exceptions. The known futures-channel BSD queue was replaced by an original synchronized FIFO. Bundled OpenSSL excludes the separately noticed SipHash implementation through no-siphash and no-quic; old and failed single-option binaries are rejected by the exclusion gate. Current static core 645b6abe passed 35 container and 29 HTTPS checks. It still contains non-allowlisted Rust Unicode data, while libc, unwind, compiler-builtins and startup inputs remain incompletely reviewed. Combined-option GNU candidate d7d42ac4 passed startup, numerical, TLS, native byte capture, mapped-source and compiler-notice checks, plus 33 container and 29 HTTPS checks on separately owned runtime infrastructure. All 927 mapped native bodies remain available by verified hash after cleanup. All 107 bodies without byte-identical package candidates were regenerated exactly from the verified locked OpenSSL archive. All 927 mapped bodies have an Apache option in their captured file or selected generator notices; three explicit BSD alternatives and twenty distribution-conditional assembly generators remain qualified by the locked OpenSSL source origin. Additional public-domain origins, include inputs and unmapped content remain under review. It has no retained SipHash symbols or objects. Its external std contains non-allowlisted components that must not be bundled. Individual-file exceptions, unmapped or inlined content, external-runtime distribution and production adoption remain uncleared. See licensing.md and runtime-link-audit.md.

jellyfin_12_behavior.detail: 106 of 364 operation declarations match; this does not measure compatible behavior. Current core 645b6abe passed 35 container and 29 HTTPS checks, including active FFmpeg shutdown, video resume and embedded metadata and explicit user-data persistence after restart. Bounded embedded music display fields import automatically after scans, with current file identity, provider precedence and unknown-credit isolation checks. Both official web and Qt 6 Desktop displayed tagged titles/discs and completed the four-track original FLAC album queue with automatic advancement, fifteen successful playback responses per client and exactly one added play per track without a state reset. Web active audio and Desktop audio EOF were observed. Exact web options delivered byte-identical original FLAC. The backend upgrade preserved grants, identity, media state, playlists and favorites. Earlier studio, native-video failures and client controls retain their exact image scopes in acceptance.md. Public Jellyfin 12 observations support embedded fields, studio filename precedence, stored folder sorting, music state and artist roles/counts. Automatic tag-named artist and album creation, embedded images, wider tags/formats, ambiguous names, complete recommendation and collection management, studio artwork and virtual enumeration, virtual-item user-data writes, broader rating filters and full Jellyfin 12 behavior remain incomplete. General Desktop startup, broader clients, native AAC, arbitrary seeking, audible quality and scale remain unvalidated. Native final-position inconsistency remains unexplained; partial user-data count, date, rating and like edits matched 46 reference cases. Two negative-value cases retain qualified constraints, and three negative-baseline cases remain unsupported. Reference keys and ended duplicate-stop edits retain qualified differences. Scanned catalogue Likes, Dislikes and favorite-only IsFavoriteOrLikes matched all 29 preserved reference observations, including exact ordered IDs, totals, statuses and the previously qualified page. Audio SortName prefixes present tagged disc and track numbers with at least four digits, preserving embedded zero and wider values. Nine reference cases matched title, SortName and disc/track fields; SortName in both directions and Name order matched. All 18 preserved ordering queries matched the reference, including numeric null placement, default name ties, mixed directions and paging. Wider collation, forced sort names, negative numbers, nonpositive NFO indexes and complete episode ordering remain incomplete or qualified. The current upgrade preserved all returned user data without exclusions; both official clients completed the four-track album again, with fifteen successful playback responses each and one added play per track. Performer and album-artist list counts now reflect the requested visible scope; sixteen normalized reference queries matched, with two qualified disabled-total order observations. List ParentId is empty even for nested physical artists. Both official clients loaded both list views successfully on current core. Automatic creation of missing tag-named artists remains open.
